t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup styled as an engineering drawing sheet on deep navy. A thin steel-blue border with zone-reference ticks numbered across and lettered down frames the sheet. Inside, a very large light-weight sans headline and smaller light subhead, then a numbered monospace table of <CONTENT> with steel-blue hairline header and column rules and off-white text. A small drawing title block with a mono document code sits in the bottom-right corner. Flat, square corners, no shadows, calm and formal.
signature_idea: The responsibility table is set as a controlled drawing: zone border, mono cells and a title block carrying the document code.
strengths: zone border and title block give a plain table a strong, on-brand document identity
mono cells and light headline match the type system
table is clean, legible and easy to build with tokens
navy plus steel-blue hairlines is the brand palette
weaknesses: beyond the sheet frame it is a plain table, no visual idea inside
headline repeats the page name; the section title is demoted to subhead
title-block fields are tiny and garbled
all-mono body is dense for seven rows of prose
brand_fit_why: Navy sheet, steel-blue hairlines, light headline, mono cells and square corners fit the brand, but it is mostly a plain table with a duplicated wordmark.
